title: From the Red Fog
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In late-nineteenth-century England, a boy raised in isolation in a cellar by an abusive mother steps out into a society split between wealth and poverty. Wherever he goes, a string of gruesome killings follows, a 'red fog' that consumes everything around him. The five-volume psychological horror story follows him as a young murderer searching for others who share his urges.
life_message: It holds up no model life; it shows how abuse and neglect can shape a killer and asks whether such a person can find connection.
